statements.quote: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, improve our existing offerings, and rapidly and responsibly deploy AI across our businesses.
statements.notes: Present tense ('continue to make'), so no year is named and kind is actual. AI deployment is one of several stated aims of total R&D investment; the sentence does not single out AI R&D, so scope is total.

statements.quote: We also expect to increase, relative to 2024, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, and data centers, to support the growth of our business and our long-term initiatives, in particular in support of AI products and services.
statements.notes: The sentence names 2024 only as the comparison base and does not name the outlook year, so fiscal_year is null. Technical-infrastructure investment is driven 'in particular' by AI but is not quantified. A near-identical sentence ('We expect to increase, relative to 2024, ...') appears in p04. It is recorded once here to avoid double-counting.
